title: Warning Against the Adulteress

questions.question: Keep my commandments and live; keep my teaching as the apple of your what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 7:2 (ESV): "keep my teaching as the apple of your eye;"

questions.question: Types of people mentioned: I have perceived among the youths, a young man lacking what?
The woman was dressed as a what?
She seizes him and kisses him, and with bold face she says to him: I had to offer what?
Her house is the way to where?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 7:27 (ESV): "Her house is the way to Sheol,"

questions.question: Bind them on your fingers; write them on the tablet of your what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 7:3 (ESV): "write them on the tablet of your heart."

questions.question: Say to wisdom, "You are my sister," and call insight your what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 7:4 (ESV): "and call insight your intimate friend,"

questions.question: Passing along the street near her corner, taking the road to her what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 7:8 (ESV): "taking the road to her house,"

questions.question: I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, aloes, and what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 7:17 (ESV): "I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon."

questions.question: For my husband is not at home; he has gone on a long what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 7:19 (ESV): "he has gone on a long journey;"

questions.question: He follows her suddenly, as an ox goes to the what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 7:22 (ESV): "as an ox goes to the slaughter,"

questions.question: Or as a stag is caught fast till an arrow pierces its what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 7:23 (ESV): "till an arrow pierces its liver;"

questions.question: Like a bird rushing into a what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 7:23 (ESV): "as a bird rushes into a snare;"

questions.question: For many a victim has she laid low, and all her slain are a what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 7:26 (ESV): "and all her slain are a mighty throng."

questions.question: Going down to the chambers of what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 7:27 (ESV): "going down to the chambers of death."

key_verse_text: Keep my commandments and live; keep my teaching as the apple of your eye;
